ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 17
   C. 3
   D. 15

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

6. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 5

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

10. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

11. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 18
   C. 8
   D. 11

12. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

13. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

14. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 64

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 14

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. D — 15
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²

Final Answer: 15 cm
